name: Product Import and Export CSV for WooCommerce
author: soyeb salar

sections.description:
Product Import and Export CSV for WooCommerce (WooCSV Pro) is a high-performance e-commerce data pipeline for WooCommerce stores. It streamlines importing and exporting catalog, inventory, and order data with streaming CSV handling, batch AJAX execution, automated WP Cron scheduling, and platform connectors.

Key Features:
* Modern UI & Dense View: Clean, unified interface with real-time feedback, compact preview cards, and dense catalog views showing 100 products per page.
* Pre-Flight Data Scanner: Automated validation scanning before import to verify required columns, SKU integrity, and formatting health.
* Live CSV Sample Preview: Dynamic real-time preview table showing the first rows of your file before running the batch.
* Smart Multi-Platform Mapping: Auto-detects and matches CSV headers with built-in presets for WooCommerce, Shopify, Magento 2, PrestaShop, BigCommerce, and OpenCart.
* Products & Variations: Stream import and export simple, variable, grouped, and external products without timeout risks.
* Orders Export: Export shop orders with HPOS (High-Performance Order Storage) support.
* Coupons & Stock: Quick-import stock quantities and import/export WooCommerce coupons.
* Categories & Product Reviews: Full import and export support for taxonomies and user reviews.
* Platform Connectors: Connect directly to Shopify, Magento 2, remote WooCommerce stores, BigCommerce, PrestaShop, and OpenCart CSV.
* External Storage Sync: Push and pull exports via FTP, SFTP, AWS S3, Google Drive, Dropbox, and Microsoft OneDrive.
* Automated Cron Schedules: Schedule imports or exports with custom recurring intervals and email completion notices.
* Developer Extensibility: Full WP-CLI commands (wp woocsv) and REST API endpoints (/wp-json/woocsv/v1/).
* High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) & Block Compatible: 100% compliant with WooCommerce modern features.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/product-import-and-export-csv-for-woocommerce directory, or install through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Access WooCSV Pro from the WordPress admin menu to start importing or exporting.
sections.faq:
Is this plugin compatible with WooCommerce HPOS?

Yes. The plugin is fully compatible with WooCommerce High-Performance Order Storage (custom_order_tables) and Cart & Checkout Blocks.

Can I import large CSV files without server timeouts?

Yes. The importer uses an offset/limit batch AJAX loop and streaming file pointers (fgetcsv), safe for massive catalogs.

Can I preview my CSV before importing?

Yes! WooCSV Pro includes both a Pre-Flight Data Scanner to detect column issues and a Live Sample Data Preview table showing parsed rows prior to running.

Where are temporary files stored?

Temporary uploads are stored in wp-content/uploads/woocsv-tmp/ and exports in wp-content/uploads/woocsv-exports/, both protected against direct HTTP directory traversal.
sections.changelog:
3.2.0

  • Feature: Complete modern UI redesign featuring unified action headers, status badges, and dense product catalog views (100 items per page).
  • Feature: Added Pre-Flight Data Scanner for CSV validation, header health checks, and SKU warnings.
  • Feature: Added Live Sample Data Preview table to inspect parsed CSV rows before execution.
  • Feature: Multi-platform smart mapping with one-click presets for WooCommerce, Shopify, Magento 2, PrestaShop, BigCommerce, and OpenCart.
  • Feature: Added automatic database schema migration for wp_woocsv_history on admin initialization.
  • Feature: Implemented full scheduled export cron execution engine for products, orders, coupons, categories, and reviews.
  • Security: Added comprehensive uninstall.php ensuring 100% zero-orphan cleanup of custom tables, options, transients, and upload directories.
  • Security: Protected woocsv-tmp directory with .htaccess and silence guard.
  • Security: Removed unauthenticated development helper script.
  • Performance: Added periodic post cache cycling during large export runs to prevent memory exhaustion.
  • Compatibility: Declared full compatibility for WooCommerce Cart & Checkout Blocks and HPOS custom order tables.
  • Maintenance: Pruned obsolete legacy assets and files.

3.1.0

  • Feature: Added Orders export module with HPOS compatibility.
  • Feature: Added Coupons import/export and Stock quick-import.
  • Feature: Added Platform Connectors (Shopify, Magento 2, WC Remote, BigCommerce, PrestaShop, OpenCart).
  • Feature: Added External Storage providers (FTP, SFTP, AWS S3, Google Drive, Dropbox, OneDrive).
  • Feature: Added Export Presets and 10-tab interactive Help page.

2.0

  • Update: Panel UI improvements.
  • Update: Replaced legacy taxonomy calls with modern WooCommerce functions.
  • Fix: Minor bug fixes and improvements.

1.0.0

  • Initial release.
